table.retrieve:
SELECT		
	item.customicode,
	item.name ,
	item.icode,
	item.PackUnits, 
	PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode,
	Date=P.Date,
	Supplier=A.Name,
	Qty = D.PackQty + D.LooseQty,
	BonusQty = D.BonusQty,
	NetRate = D.NetRate,
	SalePrice=D.SalePrice,
	Margin = Round(((D.SalePrice - D.NetRate) / CASE WHEN D.SalePrice > 0 THEN D.SalePrice ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2),
	Markup = Round(((D.SalePrice - D.NetRate) / CASE WHEN D.NetRate > 0 THEN D.NetRate ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2),
	item.SalePrice,
	Item.RecentPurPrice,
	ItemMargin = Round(((Item.SalePrice - Item.RecentPurPrice) / CASE WHEN Item.SalePrice > 0 THEN Item.SalePrice ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2),
	ItemMarkUp = Round(((Item.SalePrice - Item.RecentPurPrice) / CASE WHEN Item.RecentPurPrice > 0 THEN Item.RecentPurPrice ELSE 1 END) * 100,2),
	Item.RecentPurPrice2,
	Item.RecentPurPrice3,
	Item.RecentPurPrice4,
	Item.RecentPurPrice5,
	item.Active ,
	item.icatcode,
	item.iccode,
	item.packcode,
	item.manfcode,
	item.usercode,
	item.lastupdate,
	Item.ChangeReason,
	Item.Module
FROM 
	item ,
	manufacturer,
	purledger p,
	purdetail d,
	Accounts A
WHERE 
	p.date between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate and
	p.purinvcode = d.purinvcode and
	CASE WHEN :as_criteria = 'G' THEN 
		Round(((D.SalePrice - D.NetRate) / CASE WHEN D.SalePrice > 0 THEN D.SalePrice ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2)
	ELSE
		Round(((D.SalePrice - D.NetRate) / CASE WHEN D.NetRate > 0 THEN D.NetRate ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2)
	END BETWEEN :ad_minperc AND :ad_maxperc AND
	p.suppcode = a.acccode and
	d.icode = item.icode and
	manufacturer.manfcode = item.manfcode
table.sort: purinvcode A, date A, item_name A, qty A, netrate A
